issues.description: The problem description's narrative refers to the student-count attributes as 'inscribedStudents' and 'guestStudents', while the UML diagram and the code (template/solution) use the names 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents'. This identifier mismatch may confuse students about the exact attribute names to implement (and the constructor/getter/setter names and order).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the naming consistent across the materials. Either change the narrative in problem_statement.md to use 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents' (matching the UML and code), or explicitly state that shorter names like 'inscribedStudents' and 'guestStudents' map to the attributes 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents' to avoid ambiguity. Ensure any example constructor/signature in the text follows the UML order and exact identifiers.
